english.title: Remove / attempt to remove immobilisation device affixed to a vehicle without authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without being authorised to do so in accordance with the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Approved Devices, Charging Guidelines and General Provisions) (England) Regulations 2022, removed, or attempted to remove, an immobilisation device fixed to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in accordance with that regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13(6) of the Civil Enforcement of Road Traffic Contraventions (Approved Devices, Charging Guidelines and General Provisions) (England) Regulations 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationremoved / attempt tp remove an immobilisation devicefixed to a vehiclewithout authority

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Where a penalty charge notice has been given under regulation 9 an immobilisation device may be fixed to the vehicle while it remains in the place it was found.
